title: Brand document
description: The parameterisation layer (DESIGN.md 5.3, FR-009/FR-010). Written by the Strategist from the brief; read by every other agent. Every agent except the Reviewer reads THIS and never the raw brief (FR-011). Structure, not prose, because three consumers need fields: the Web Builder needs real hex values, the Reviewer needs checkable do/don't items, and the deploy probe needs `name` as a queryable field. The schema is fixed; the contents are generated per client and the schema MUST NOT change to accommodate one.

name.description: The string the deploy probe asserts is present in the response body, read from this row at verify time (DESIGN.md 4.5, FR-018). Never a literal in source.

palette.description: Concrete hex values chosen by the Strategist. Specificity is the anti-slop lever (DESIGN.md 6.3); an under-specified palette is what produces the generic result.

composition_archetype.description: Selected from the site section-layout library, not authored.

video_archetype.description: Selected from the Remotion archetype library (DESIGN.md 6.4). The Strategist selects; the Marketer fills props.

composition_plan.description: Section-level plan handed to the Web Builder so it composes rather than invents a page (DESIGN.md 6.3). Contains layout intent only — never copy, never a price, never a claim.

offerings.description: The fact channel. Every agent except the Reviewer reads this document and never the raw brief (FR-011), so without these fields there is no route by which what the business sells reaches the words that sell it — the anti-fabrication rules then correctly produce a page stating nothing. Mirrors brief.schema.json's `products[]` field-for-field minus `currency_charge`, which is Ops' charging detail and belongs on no page. Copied verbatim by the Strategist; never paraphrased, repriced or trimmed. Named typed fields, not prose: the containment argument (DESIGN.md 9.6) survives because there is still no free channel from the brief into an agent's prompt. Schedule and location facts need no field of their own — they live in `description`/`features`, whose numerals are already in runs.grounding_set.

price_minor.description: Minor units, as the brief has it. A reader states it in the display currency's normal major form; the normaliser reduces both sides to minor units, so the major form matches and the raw minor number beside a currency marker does not.
